title: デビュー戦の後に・荒

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's performance certainly impresses the spectators, but she is thoroughly exhausted afterward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to her older sister, Biwa Hayahide, Brian wasn't running like normal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I investigate the data I have on Narita Brian to find the cause and learn that her experience racing against multiple opponents is lacking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This discovery could draw attention to her weakness. We need to overcome it by the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.
